notes: Two visibility fixes so the per-user permission tiers (from 1.19.0) are respected everywhere, not just on the pages themselves: 1) The Settings / AI Costs / Update shortcuts above 'Sign out' in the top-right user menu now only show up if that user actually has access to the matching page - a user with none of the three sees just their name and Sign out. 2) The dashboard's stats cards (free service requests, hidden/orphaned translations, AI spend) now show only the cards for sections that user has view access to, and the whole card row disappears if none apply. No database changes.
